question:
Here is my code

models:
  dbt-cts-training:
    tranform:
      +schema: transforming

when I try to crate models under transforming schema but when I ran the model it is creating under the default schema

I can't seem to find the error.

when I try the config() in the model itself the model is creating under the custom schema

I want to crate model under custom schema by using the dbt_project.yml file
title: model is not creating undet the custom schema in DBT
answer: I suspect the issue is that you have used tranform in your YML and your directory may be called transform with an 's', causing the config to miss your model.
